AREAD134.DAT:7:5.speaker: unknown
AREAD134.DAT:7:5.t: Voce quer voltar para o mundo exterior?

AREAD134.DAT:7:6.speaker: unknown
AREAD134.DAT:7:6.t: Parece que esses pilares sao o que esta[01]prendendo quem quer que seja aqui.

AREAD134.DAT:7:7.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:7.risk_notes: Fou-Lu's archaic register critical; preserves majesty and poignancy of imprisonment; 'trapped' conveyed through formal 'aprisionado'
AREAD134.DAT:7:7.t: [14][01][01]"Como podeis ver, acho-me[01]aprisionado neste lugar.[02]Seria de extrema[01]gratidao se pudesseis[01]libertar-me daqui."

AREAD134.DAT:7:8.speaker: unknown
AREAD134.DAT:7:8.risk_notes: Identity uncertainty critical; markers [04][05] preserve spoiler ambiguity; must not resolve who speaker is

AREAD134.DAT:7:9.speaker: unknown
AREAD134.DAT:7:9.risk_notes: Generic gender-neutral construction to avoid spoiler; 'entao voce eh' preserves ambiguity of identity

AREAD134.DAT:7:10.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:10.risk_notes: Fou-Lu's exasperation must use archaic imperious tone ('Quem mais poderia ser!?'); avoids modern casual; back-translation required to confirm majesty and urgency coexist
AREAD134.DAT:7:10.t: [14][01][01]"Quem mais poderia ser!?[01]Naturalmente que sou![02]Agora dissipai esses[01]pilares e libertai-me[01]deste lugar!"

AREAD134.DAT:7:11.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:11.risk_notes: Archaic imperative 'deveis destruir'; formal conditional preserves Fou-Lu's grave tone despite practical instruction
AREAD134.DAT:7:11.t: [14][01][01]"Se desejais libertar-me,[02]ide destruir aqueles[01]pilares que me[01]aprisionar aqui."

AREAD134.DAT:7:12.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:12.risk_notes: Fou-Lu's relief uses archaic 'Enfim!' and formal 'ali' (there) to maintain register consistency; never drops to casual pt-BR

AREAD134.DAT:7:13.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:13.risk_notes: Formal thanks ('agradeco-vos') and archaic 'contudo' preserve Fou-Lu's solemnity even in gratitude
AREAD134.DAT:7:13.t: [14][01][01]"Antes de tudo, devo[01]agradeco-vos pela ajuda.[02]Restou ainda um[01]problema, porem..."

AREAD134.DAT:7:14.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:14.risk_notes: Identity/existence revelation critical; 'nao tenho corpo' (no body) is existential shock; archaic register maintained despite bombshell content

AREAD134.DAT:7:15.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:15.risk_notes: Logical consequence of lack of body; 'isto significa' preserves formal tone while explaining limitation

AREAD134.DAT:7:16.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:16.risk_notes: Request for medium uses formal 'desejo' and archaic phrasing; 'que me emprestem corpo' (loan body) preserves original's oddness appropriately
AREAD134.DAT:7:16.t: [14][01][01]"Por isso desejo[01]que encontreis uma[02]medium que possa[01]emprestar-me um corpo."

AREAD134.DAT:7:17.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:17.risk_notes: Archaic imperative 'nao vos preocupeis'; 'deuses e afins' captures colloquial original while maintaining formal register; byte budget tight but maintained
AREAD134.DAT:7:17.t: [14][01][01]"Nao vos preocupeis--[01]aqui invocam deuses e[02]afins! Ha de haver[01]muitas mediums por[01]aqui!"

AREAD134.DAT:7:18.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD134.DAT:7:18.risk_notes: Fou-Lu's rare moment of vanity ('boa aparencia') uses archaic phrasing ('procurem uma bonita'); 'Tentar' from glossary (UI verb); back-translation critical to confirm humor survives archaic register
AREAD134.DAT:7:18.t: [14][01][01]"Lembrai-vos, uma vez de[01]volta la fora,[02]precisais encontrar uma[01]medium. Ah, e...[02]Tentem encontrar uma[01]de boa aparencia,[01]se conseguirem, ta bem?"
